description: Unified observable calculation for Scale 1 (24q QAOA) vs Scale 2 E2a (79q). P_hw = P(k=k_opt AND full coverage). P_fc = P(full coverage, any k). E_reduction_pct = (E_rnd - E_hw) / (E_rnd - E_opt) * 100 (normalized QUBO reduction). All three metrics computed to assess referee concern about comparing P_hw (Scale 1) vs P_fc (Scale 2) vs E_reduction_pct.

scale1.P_hw_source: p_real_sc from kingston_qaoa_results.json (computed over all 4096 shots)
scale1.P_fc_source: p_real_cov from kingston_qaoa_results.json (computed over all 4096 shots)
scale1.note: P_hw = P(k=k_opt AND full coverage) = p_real_sc. P_fc = P(full coverage, any k) = p_real_cov. IMPORTANT: counts dict stores only unique bitstrings (not full distribution). Authoritative P values come from pre-computed p_real_sc and p_real_cov fields which were computed over all 4096 shots. E_rnd reconstructed from E_reduction_pct definition. E_opt = k_opt = 10 (perfect coverage, zero penalty). Coverage matrix A: 24 PEF bases x 23 waypoints, R=200km.

scale2_E2a.P_hw_note: Cannot compute from available data: only top10 bitstrings stored, each with count=1. Full counts not available for Scale 2.

observable_P_fc.note: P_fc is the same quantity in both scales. S1=P(cov, any k), S2=p_cov_real from hardware. Direct comparison is valid.

observable_P_hw.note: P_hw (k=k_opt AND cov) computed for S1 from full bitstring counts. S2 not available: kingston_arco_fogo_results only stores top10 counts. This metric CANNOT be unified from available data.

observable_E_normalized.note: E_normalized is the RECOMMENDED unified observable. It is scale-independent (normalized to [0%, 100%]), comparable across n_b=24 and n_b=79. S1 and S2 use the same QUBO formulation with lam=10.

unified_comparison.referee_concern: The paper's '24% vs 35.9%' comparison: 24% refers to E_reduction_pct for S1 (Scale 1, 24q); 35.9% refers to E_reduction_pct for S2 E2a (Scale 2 R=100km). Both are E_normalized — the comparison IS valid and uses the same observable. The concern about P_hw vs P_fc is a separate issue: p_real_sc (P_hw) and p_real_cov (P_fc) are both reported for S1 in the JSON. The paper should clarify which P is being reported in each table row.
